## Checklist

- [ ] All five gates pass locally (`format:check`, `lint`, `typecheck`, `test`, `build`)
- [ ] Tests cover the change (regression test for a bug fix)
- [ ] Documentation updated if behavior or contracts changed (`docs/CLI_SPEC.md`, `docs/DECISIONS.md`)
- [ ] No prompt content is executed; no network calls added
- [ ] Fixtures, examples and docs are synthetic and contain no personal data or secrets
